Description:
A map which, it is *possibly* safe to presume, will lead you to treasure. *Potentially*.

※Level 100 full party (8 players) recommended.

A faded map one would *presume* reveals the location of a teleportation portal leading to a hidden stage *presumably* filled with unimaginable riches.

※Level 100 full party (8 players) recommended.
One cannot help but wonder: how many low-quality fire crystals does it take to thaw out a frozen isle?
A tender slice of meat received from J'yhuh Tia. At a glance, its quality is impeccable.
